text:
taylor: heads-up I pushed a tiny docs PR that cleans up the quickstart flow: canonical env var, a Python example using the new sync client, and a brief one-step Docker deploy. PR #4370.

leo: nice. what's the canonical env var now? we had like three in old samples.

taylor: REDWOOD_API_KEY only. added a short note for legacy setups that still use LEGACY_TOKEN.

sam: can you drop the Python snippet? I want to check import/return shape.

taylor: sure, here's the snippet from the PR: 

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-1", prompt="hello")
print(resp.output)  # contains text, tokens, and meta
client.close()
```

taylor: also a single-line Docker run hint for the quickstart: 

```
docker build -t hello-redwood . && docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY hello-redwood
```

emma: small ask: call out Node and Python minimum versions and add a one-liner for loading a .env in dev. folks keep hitting ESM/CommonJS surprises.

leo: also update the sample to use `resp.output` (not `resp.text`) like we standardized. good to mention `client.close()` for tests so CI doesn't leak handles.

sam: on error guidance  maybe add a short troubleshooting bullet: invalid token -> 401 hint + link to token rotation guide. keep streaming out of quickstart; add it to appendix.

taylor: agreed. I removed streaming from the main snippet and added a short appendix link.

emma: can you also fix two broken links I found in the README: the private-deploy guide (404) and the KMS section. I'll paste the corrected URLs in the PR comments.

taylor: thanks, pasted em. deploy-bot: staging docs deployment queued for 2026-03-24 02:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: docs PR #4370 built: staging preview available at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/4370

leo: I reviewed the code shapes, lgtm from SDK POV. sam you want to sanity-check the Docker cmd?

sam: quick smoke: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx hello-redwood` works locally. I'll run the staging preview and look for any old env references.

taylor: great. I'll merge after sam and emma sign off and then do a tiny follow-up to add the migration blurb to the workshop slides. :sparkles:
